claims: The 2026 NCAA Tournament First Four is held in Dayton, Ohio.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament First Four is held March 17–18.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament First Four features eight teams competing to fill the final spots in the 64-team bracket.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament First Four matchups include No. 16 Howard vs. No. 16 UMBC.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament First Four matchups include No. 11 Texas vs. No. 11 NC State.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament First Four matchups include Prairie View A&M vs. Lehigh.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament First Four matchups include Miami (Ohio) vs. SMU.
The 2026 Men's First Four matchups are held in Dayton, OH.
Howard defeated UMBC 86-83 in the 2026 Men's First Four on Tuesday, March 17.
The halftime score in the Texas vs. NC State game of the 2026 Men's First Four on Tuesday, March 17 was Texas 30, NC State 25.
Prairie View A&M vs. Lehigh is a 2026 Men's First Four matchup on Wednesday, March 18.
Miami (Ohio) vs. SMU is a 2026 Men's First Four matchup on Wednesday, March 18.
Nebraska vs. Richmond is a 2026 Women's First Four matchup on Wednesday, March 18.
Missouri State vs. Stephen F. Austin is a 2026 Women's First Four matchup on Wednesday, March 18.
Southern vs. Samford is a 2026 Women's First Four matchup on Thursday, March 19.
Virginia vs. Arizona State is a 2026 Women's First Four matchup on Thursday, March 19.
The First Four acts as the official opening round of March Madness.
Winners of the First Four advance to the first round of the main tournament.
